# Rapier 3D 0.19.3

`rapier.mjs` is the unmodified ESM distribution (including embedded WebAssembly)
from `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.19.3` (https://github.com/dimforge/rapier.js).
The Apache 2.0 license is included as `rapier.LICENSE`.

The local pinned copy is shared by Yatsun's browser worker and Node physics
tests, and makes rolling independent of CDN availability.
